title: How to Advertise on Peacock: 2026 Guide

facts.fact: The article was published on 2026-10-27.
facts.quote: Published Time: 2026-10-27

facts.fact: Universal Ads, which the article describes as Comcast's self-service TV advertising platform, advertises no minimum spend.
facts.quote: Universal Ads advertises no minimum spend, but “no minimum” is not the same as “enough budget to learn.”

facts.fact: Universal Ads' current site describes access to NBCUniversal and other premium publishers with no platform minimum spend.
facts.quote: its current site describes access to NBCUniversal and other premium publishers with no platform minimum spend

facts.fact: Universal Ads' quick-start guide suggests a $10 starting bid for competitiveness across much of its inventory, according to the article; the article notes this is not a guaranteed Peacock clearing price.
facts.quote: The platform’s quick-start guide suggests a $10 starting bid for competitiveness across much of its inventory.

facts.fact: Universal Ads offers 2 main campaign types: Performance+ and Content Select.
facts.quote: Advertisers can choose between 2 main campaign types:

facts.fact: Universal Ads recommends starting with no more than 1-2 targeting layers for CTV tests.
facts.quote: Universal Ads recommends starting with no more than 1-2 targeting layers.

facts.fact: Universal Ads supports plain-text and SHA-256 hashed identifiers under its current custom-audience rules.
facts.quote: Universal Ads supports plain-text and SHA-256 hashed identifiers under its current custom-audience rules.

facts.fact: Peacock's current advertising page highlights Spotlight, contextual Pause Ads and Engagement Ads as products.
facts.quote: Peacock’s current advertising page highlights products such as Spotlight, contextual Pause Ads and Engagement Ads.

facts.fact: For Universal Ads standard video, the article says the creative should be submitted as exact-duration 16:9 video.
facts.quote: submit exact-duration 16:9 video

facts.fact: For standard video through Universal Ads, the article says the asset must be exported to the exact intended duration.
facts.quote: Export the asset to the exact intended duration.

facts.fact: Universal Ads lists the current Peacock video creative dimensions as 1920 x 1080 pixels.
facts.quote: | Dimensions | 1920 x 1080 |

facts.fact: Universal Ads lists the current Peacock video aspect ratio as 16:9.
facts.quote: | Aspect ratio | 16:9 |

facts.fact: Universal Ads lists a maximum video file size of 250 MB for Peacock creative.
facts.quote: | Maximum file size | 250 MB |

facts.fact: Universal Ads lists a video bitrate of 10 Mbps or higher for Peacock creative.
facts.quote: | Video bitrate | 10 Mbps or higher |

facts.fact: Universal Ads lists Peacock video durations of 15, 30 or 60 seconds, with no stitching.
facts.quote: | Duration | 15, 30 or 60 seconds, with no stitching |

facts.fact: Universal Ads lists a frame rate of 23.98, 24.25 or 30 fps for Peacock creative, as currently listed.
facts.quote: | Frame rate | 23.98, 24.25 or 30 fps, as currently listed |

facts.fact: Universal Ads lists a minimum audio bitrate of 192 Kbps and a 48,000 Hz sampling rate for Peacock creative.
facts.quote: | Audio | 192 Kbps minimum, 48,000 Hz sampling |

facts.fact: Universal Ads lists a loudness specification of average -24 LUFS, plus or minus 2 LUFS, for Peacock creative.
facts.quote: | Loudness | Average -24 LUFS, plus or minus 2 LUFS |

facts.fact: The guide states that publishers may round fractional seconds, so a 30.5-second file can be treated as 31 seconds and lose eligibility for a 30-second placement.
facts.quote: Publishers may round fractional seconds. A 30.5-second file can be treated as 31 seconds and lose eligibility for a 30-second placement.

facts.fact: Universal Ads states that most ads are reviewed within 48 hours, although some reviews take longer.
facts.quote: Universal Ads states that most ads are reviewed within 48 hours, although some reviews take longer.

facts.fact: Universal Ads currently promotes no minimum spend and is designed for advertisers of different sizes.
facts.quote: Universal Ads is designed for advertisers of different sizes and currently promotes no minimum spend.

facts.fact: The Universal Ads Creative Requirements help article was updated October 22, 2026.
facts.quote: [Universal Ads Creative Requirements](https://help.universalads.com/hc/en-us/articles/32169789863451-Creative-Requirements). Updated October 22, 2026.

facts.fact: The NBCUniversal One Platform Total Audience announcement is dated January 8, 2024.
facts.quote: [NBCUniversal One Platform Total Audience](https://www.nbcuniversal.com/article/nbcuniversal-redefines-cross-platform-advertising-industry-one-platform-total-audience). January 8, 2024.

facts.fact: The NBCUniversal 2026 Upfront presentation is dated May 11, 2026.
facts.quote: [NBCUniversal 2026 Upfront](https://www.nbcuniversal.com/article/nbcuniversal-delivers-next-era-media-and-advertising-2026-upfront-presentation). May 11, 2026.
